name: premium-commercial-keynote-visual-system

principles: Route by proof object first: metric, process, architecture, case image, value chain, risk, manifesto.
Use photos as evidence or showcase unless the image has a clean safe zone for text.
Vary rhythm at contact-sheet scale: stage cover, editorial content, proof object, system map, gallery, close.

strategy-map.proofObject: flow from drivers to actions to outcomes

culture-manifesto.proofObject: one strong statement plus supporting values

risk-matrix.proofObject: prioritized matrix, not a plain table

claimSpine.rule: Every slide needs one claim, one proof object, and only the supporting text needed to read the proof.

semanticColorTokens.darkText: Primary readable text on dark pages.
semanticColorTokens.darkMuted: Secondary text and quiet metadata on dark pages.
semanticColorTokens.darkLine: Borders, dividers, and diagram lines on dark pages.
semanticColorTokens.panelAlt: Alternative panel fill for light pages.
semanticColorTokens.photoOverlay: Overlay color used to control photo contrast.
semanticColorTokens.captionOnImage: Caption text over darkened image bands.

roleFit.background: Require wide aspect ratio and a clean text safe zone; busy product, factory, table, or screenshot images are rejected as backgrounds.
roleFit.showcase: Keep the subject visible in a dedicated image area; do not overlay paragraphs.
roleFit.evidence: Use framed panels and captions; screenshots and field photos remain inspectable.
roleFit.gallery: Use consistent crop ratios and captions; image quality beats image count.

general-operations.label: DIGITAL OPERATIONS
general-operations.insight: 让业务闭环建立在统一数据之上
general-operations.coreBody: 以中心能力雷达串联关键模块，表达平台不是功能堆叠，而是围绕业务闭环形成能力场。

manufacturing-operations.label: MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS
manufacturing-operations.insight: 让设备状态成为现场协同的起点
manufacturing-operations.coreBody: 以设备状态雷达串联资产、报警、工单、保养、备件和生产指标，形成现场运维闭环。

industrial-park.label: INDUSTRIAL PARK OPERATIONS
industrial-park.insight: 让园区服务围绕空间与企业流动
industrial-park.coreBody: 以空间、企业、服务、资产与运营指标为核心节点，形成园区管理与服务协同网络。

healthcare-operations.label: HEALTHCARE OPERATIONS
healthcare-operations.insight: 让服务质量、资源调度和患者体验进入同一套运营视图
healthcare-operations.coreBody: 以患者旅程、医护资源、服务响应、风险治理和质量指标为核心，形成可信、合规、可追踪的医疗运营闭环。

finance-investment.label: FINANCE / INVESTMENT
finance-investment.insight: 让投资判断建立在统一口径、风险约束和资本效率之上
finance-investment.coreBody: 以市场假设、核心指标、组合风险、资本配置和复盘机制为核心，形成面向管理层的决策闭环。

brand-retail.label: BRAND RETAIL
brand-retail.insight: 以产品组合、空间体验与会员运营构建可复盘增长闭环
brand-retail.coreBody: 以产品、门店、内容、会员和经营指标为核心，形成从品牌记忆到复购经营的增长闭环。

energy-utility.label: ENERGY OPERATIONS
energy-utility.insight: 让电站运行从事后巡检走向实时调度
energy-utility.coreBody: 以设备状态、负荷曲线、储能策略、告警工单与收益指标为核心，形成电站运行闭环。

boardroom-ink.intent: Default premium business palette for technology, operations, and client proposals.

japan-editorial-navy.intent: Japanese-style business clarity: navy structure, off-white background, restrained accent.

graphite-ivory.intent: Premium but quiet palette for professional services, real estate, culture, and luxury-adjacent decks.

sage-operations.intent: Calm operations palette for healthcare, ESG, education, and service quality decks.

signal-charcoal.intent: High-contrast product, AI, security, and launch decks; use sparingly.

finance-slate.intent: Conservative executive reporting, finance, investment, and governance decks.

warm-white-redline.intent: Editorial corporate palette for brand, retail, culture, and leadership narratives.

backgroundModes.solid: Use palette-driven pure or near-solid backgrounds. Best for data-heavy, management, legal, finance, governance, strategy, and internal reports.
backgroundModes.photo: Use a high-quality full-bleed or split photo when the image is evidence or creates the scene. Always darken or wash the image for text contrast.
backgroundModes.hybrid: Use a mostly solid slide with one disciplined photo panel, band, or case image. Best for product, case, site, manufacturing, energy, real estate, retail, healthcare, and education.
backgroundModes.generated: Use generated bitmap assets only when no real source asset exists and the slide needs an abstract scene, texture, product metaphor, or high-quality visual backdrop.
backgroundModes.case-gallery: Use multiple real images when the deck is case-led, portfolio-led, product-led, property-led, venue-led, or before/after-led.

imageRoles.background: Atmospheric photo with safe text zones. Never use a busy product/equipment/screenshot image as background.
imageRoles.showcase: Product, equipment, production line, venue, or object that must be clearly visible. Text lives in a separate solid area.
imageRoles.evidence: Site photo, screenshot, case proof, or detail image. Use a bordered panel and short caption.
imageRoles.comparison: Before/after or old/new image pair. Split into comparison zones instead of using a combined image as a background.
imageRoles.gallery: Multiple case/product/place images with consistent crop ratios and captions.

default.assetPolicy: Prefer solid backgrounds unless a user-provided or clearly sourced image directly proves the slide claim.

energy-utility.assetPolicy: Use real station/storage imagery selectively; internal pages should stay mostly structural unless discussing sites, assets, cases, or field context.

manufacturing-operations.assetPolicy: Use factory/equipment photos for field evidence; use solid layouts for process, OEE, KPI, and architecture pages.

industrial-park.assetPolicy: Use spatial/park images for place context and case pages; keep management and risk pages clean.

healthcare-operations.assetPolicy: Use calm, human-safe imagery only when relevant; avoid decorative medical stock photos.

finance-investment.assetPolicy: Prefer solid backgrounds, charts, evidence tables, and conservative contrast. Photos are exceptional.

brand-retail.assetPolicy: Use product, venue, packaging, and campaign visuals as proof; keep text areas disciplined and uncluttered.

motifs.breathing_circle: Low-contrast circular field for dark and light canvases. Use it as atmosphere, never as a busy diagram.
motifs.energy_lens: Energy-specific field made from circles, one quiet pulse curve, and minimal metric labels. No repeated diagonal slash decoration.
motifs.energy_photo_backdrop: Real BESS site photo, dark-graded for cover and closing pages. Use for energy-utility decks when the deck needs a stronger first impression than vector-only atmosphere.
motifs.energy_photo_detail: A tighter BESS detail crop for inner-page editorial splits, problem pages, and value pages. It should support the narrative instead of acting as decoration.
motifs.energy_photo_band: A panoramic BESS band for chapter navigation and rollout pages. Use as a quiet grounding layer near the bottom or edge of the canvas.
motifs.energy_motion_backdrop: Five-second slow-push MP4 derived from the energy photo. Optional only; use when the output environment supports embedded video cleanly.
motifs.operating_loop: Closed oval loop for capability maps. Prefer one clean closed form over mixed ellipses plus arrows.

rules: Every visual line must explain structure, flow, or data; decorative diagonal stripe clusters are forbidden.
Chinese titles use PingFang SC or the platform fallback; Latin labels use Avenir Next; numbers use DIN Alternate.
Premium pages should feel spatial and calm first, detailed second.
Use one accent color per slide unless a chart or risk matrix genuinely needs a second signal color.
Prefer near-white or near-black backgrounds over pure white or pure black for long decks.
Images must be evidence, place, product, people, or case context. Do not add images just because a pure-color slide feels empty.
